graph.title: LEGO Architecture 21003 Seattle Space Needle
notes: Piece ids follow build order: b1-2 plates 4x10; b3-6 tiles 1x8; b7-8 plates 4x6; b9-12 tiles 1x6; b13-14 round plates; b15 axle 5; b16-19 tiles 2x2; b20 dish; b21-23 angled connectors; b24 hub; b25-26 bevel gears; b27 bush; b28-31 and b36 axle connectors; b32-35 red axles; b37 axle 3; b38 pulley; b39 axle connector; b40 bush; b41 axle 5; b42-44 angled connectors; b45 hub; b46-48 hoses; b49 dish; b50 round plate; b51 40T gear; b52 dish; b53 round plate; b54 antenna; b55 4x4 dish; b56 1x1 round plate; b57 2x2 dish.
Exact stud-level positions of the base plates and tiles are not readable from the small black-on-black pictures; each tile or plate is joined to the plate(s) it straddles with null ports.
Hose pieces are cut to 133 mm per step 15 and each runs from a lower angled connector to an upper one; the hose has no ports in the catalogue so ports are null.
The hub centre axle hole has no catalogue port, so hub-to-axle joins use a null port on the hub.

Step 9-10 stack order of axle connectors and red axles is inferred: axle connectors b28-b31, then b36 are chained by the four red axles; the exact order of b39/b40/b38 on axle 3 is inferred from the pictures.
Dish pieces 44375a have no stud ports in the catalogue, so joins to dish tops use null ports.
